messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the invite ops for the next design partner wave. target = 24 partners across 4 cohorts. RSVP window ideas?
Ajay (Eng): 7-day RSVP seems tight given legal/NDA steps. maybe 10 business days.
Sam (PartnerOps): +1 to 10 biz days. We should also add a one-click calendar accept to reduce friction.
Elaine (Res): also ask for 2 sample prompts during sign-up so we can triage model-coverage early. keeps early evals realistic.
Maya (PM): good call. propose: initial invite -> 10 business day RSVP -> intake survey (incl. 2 prompts) -> NDA link -> kickoff scheduling. any blockers?
Ajay (Eng): capacity wise we can onboard 6 partners/week. If we stagger cohorts weekly that's fine. but need to freeze model variants per cohort to avoid eval drift.
Sam (PartnerOps): ops checklist draft: 
```
- Send invite (template V2)
- Intake survey link
- Auto NDA (HelloSign)
- Calendar invite placeholder
- Onboard guide + redwood-quickstart repo link
```
Maya (PM): can you drop that checklist into the shared sheet? link it to the invite row so reviewers see status.
Sam (PartnerOps): done — sheet updated: https://redwood.work/sheets/dp-invite-ops (view-only until I add you) :white_check_mark:
Elaine (Res): about incentives — we should offer usage credits + 1:1 research session. credits tiered by engagement (low/med/high). keeps people motivated to run evals.
Maya (PM): agree. draft incentive tiers: 250 credits + 1 session (low), 1k + 2 sessions (med), 2k + 3 sessions + spotlight (high). feedback?
Ajay (Eng): fine. also add a small SLA for dedicated capacity if customer needs it — call it "pilot burst" clause. ops-bot should flag if capacity request > 2x baseline.
ops-bot: note created: pilot-capacity-flag rule added to infra alerts.
Sam (PartnerOps): on messaging tone — keep it clear: "short intake survey", "we’ll review and follow up within 3 business days". avoids dropped expectations.
Maya (PM): launch criteria for wave: 1) 24 invites sent, 2) 70% RSVP within window, 3) onboarding runbook validated by Eng/Res, 4) partner kickoff scheduled for first cohort.
Elaine (Res): plus: three eval prompts captured and at least one automated eval passing basic quality thresholds before cohort 1.
Ajay (Eng): reminder: lock quantization/profile for cohort models 72h before kickoff. prevents last-minute infra churn.
Maya (PM): next steps: Sam to finalize invite template & sheet by EOD Fri; Ajay to confirm capacity/lock plan by Mon; Elaine to finalize intake survey prompt template by Mon. I'll collate and send final invite batch next Tue.
Sam (PartnerOps): on it. putting a small follow-up automation to ping non-responders at day 4 and day 8.
Ajay (Eng): noted. tagging infra on the sheet for burst allowances.
Maya (PM): perfect. if no objections, i'll post the invite draft to #product-docs for one last pass before send. :rocket:
